summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiary, Honghwa International Corporation, acquired a right-of-use asset from the parent company. The transaction involves a lease of 1,312 pings of office space at NT$1,003 per ping per month, totaling NT$78,979,560 over five years, with a right-of-use asset value of NT$71,427,604. The board approved the related-party transaction on April 24, 2026, citing cost and business requirements. No professional appraisal was obtained. This is a routine related-party lease agreement, not a special situation. No special-situation dynamics apply.
